newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-Stomach pains end Edwards' rugby season.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-Stomach pains end Edwards' rugby season.

text.p: WELLINGTON, Sept 18 - It has taken Mike Edwards five seasons to cement his place in the Wellington rugby team's front row -- and now his body has let him down.
Wellington's No 1 prop today rued his inability to make Saturday's national championship battle with Auckland, a team which he loves to play against, NZPA reports.

Instead he has to remain in Wellington Hospital for several more days, while doctors run tests to find out what caused the abdominal pains which led to an exploratory operation at Hutt Hospital on Monday night.
It's the end of Edwards' season.
"It's a pity about Auckland, I like playing against them," Edwards said.
Wellington coach Frank Walker said Edwards' injury came at a bad time.
"He will be out for the season. He's a sad loss because Mike's been playing well," Walker said.
"He's a good team member and he's thoroughly enjoyed playing against Auckland in past seasons -- so he's really brassed off. He wanted to play.
"Ross (team manager Ross Thurston) said that when he came out of the operation the first thing he said was -- 'where's the gym, I've got to go to the gym'."
